MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
Mizoram New Capital Complex20
Aizawl
N O T I F I C A T I O N
(LDE (Non-Gazetted Post) No. 20 of 2026 – 2027)
Dated Aizawl, the 6th August, 2026
No.A.34012/14/2026-MPSC(PRE): Limited Departmental Examination for the
under mentioned post is to be conducted by the Mizoram Public Service
Commission. Application can be submitted through the Mizoram Public
Service Commission’s online portal https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in
Probable applicants who have not registered in the one-time-registration
portal must register and submit their application well in advance before the
last date of submission of application to enable them to submit their
application in time.
An applicant must verify that his/her application is actually submitted after
payment is made, otherwise the claim of any applicant regarding his/her
candidature will not be entertained.
1. Name of Department : Lunglei Judicial District, Law & Judicial
2. Name of Post : Bench Clerk Grade-II
3. Classification : Group ‘B’ (Non-Gazetted)
4. No. of Posts : 2 (Two)
5. Pay : Level 6 in the Pay Matrix
6. Relevant Rules : Mizoram District Court Service Rules, 2018.
7. Conditions of Eligibility : Must have put in not less than 3 years
regular service in the cadre of Bench Clerk
Grade-III.
8. Last Date of Application : 21.08.2026 till 4:00 PM
9. Date of Examination : 14 – 18 September, 2026
10. Syllabus: for the examination is available for download on the
Commission’s official website https://tinyurl.com/syllabusfor-benchclerk-
gr-i-ii
11. Mandatory documents to be uploaded :
(i) To support their applications, the candidates must upload the
following documents in the online portal, positively before expiry
of the period specified for submission of the application:-
Page 2 of 3
(a) Service Book Entry showing date of joining of Bench Clerk
Grade-III.
(b) Service book entry showing date of birth.
(c) Confirmation Order.
(d) Certification by HoD or Cadre Authority in the format
prescribed by the Commission.
(e) Documents, if any for which there is no assigned box for
uploading should be uploaded in the “Others” box/field of the
OTR Page of the online portal (Multiple documents can be
uploaded in the “Others” box/field).
Note: Supporting documents to be uploaded should not be
protected from any person for viewing or printing etc.
Any uploaded file which is protected in the said manner will
be considered as not uploaded.
(ii) Validity of the candidature of an applicant shall be assessed
based on the documents uploaded in the online portal only.
(iii) Any application for alteration of documents already uploaded by
the candidate in the online portal should be made well before
the last date of application in order that such modification would
become effective before the expiry of the last date.
(iv) Any alteration of documents made in the portal after the last
date for submission of application shall not be considered for the
particular post applied for.
(v) Failure to upload any of the mandatory documents by the closing
date for submission of application will result in rejection of the
application.
12. Disqualifications :
(i) Canvassing (insawipui) by a candidate directly or indirectly will
disqualify his/her candidature.
(ii) Particulars/Details to be mentioned in the application should be
completely and correctly stated. Any application not specifying
the required information of a concerned candidate shall be
liable to be rejected.
(iii) Any candidate who, on verification at any stage of the
recruitment process, does not fulfill any of the eligibility conditions
will be disqualified. Accordingly, a candidate remains liable to
disqualification even after appearing for written examination.
Page 3 of 3
(iv) Any candidate who fails to submit his/her application with
supporting documents as required, during the stipulated time
period shall be disqualified.
13. If payment is to be done through UPI, it may be done using only the
mobile number used for one time registration. Persons with disabilities
are exempted from payment of application fees. Fees once paid is
non-refundable under any circumstances.
14. Helpline: In case of queries/clarification regarding their applications,
candidature, etc. candidates may contact MPSC’s Helpline No. 0389-
3596493 on working days between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM. Applicants
can also approach the MPSC on all working days during office hours.
Sd/-TERESY VANLALHRUAII
Secretary
